note: Set from the 2021-22 to 2025-26 backtest. learn.py updates the weights weekly when the guardrails in README pass. projection.gameShrink pulls game totals toward league average (fit on 6,560 games); projection.soShare is the share of tied games that reach a shootout, used to count the shootout winner's goal the way books settle totals.

history.why: Initial backtest: offense and opponent defense carry most of the signal; PP/PK, last-5 and luck added nothing once those were in.
